The main takeaway from our work is that

the near-in-frared excess in HD 163296, and possibly in many other Herbig Ae stars, arises from an extended and point-symmetric inner disk region that is optically thin and dominated by the emission from refractory grains.
the near-instrument emission in Herbig Ae stars is not necessarily dominated by optically thick gas.
the innermost region of HD163296 is very different from what is observed in the T Tauri star AB Aurigae and may represent a new phase of evolution of Herbig Ae disks.
